system_development.meaning: Design, development, construction, implementation, modification, replacement, or renewal of an information system.
system_development.boundary: A title containing the generic word システム is not enough unless it also indicates a development or implementation action.

system_services.meaning: Provision of, or usage support for, an information system when the title does not explicitly describe development or operations.
examples: 検索システム提供役務
情報システム利用支援
system_services.boundary: Physical or non-information systems are outside the intended scope.

software_applications.meaning: Procurement, provision, licensing, development, or support of software and applications.
examples: アプリケーション改修
software_applications.boundary: Generic licenses without a clear software or application context are not matched.

operations_maintenance.meaning: Ongoing operation, administration, support, or maintenance of an information system.
operations_maintenance.boundary: Maintenance of scientific, mechanical, camera, or other physical equipment may be outside scope unless an information system is explicit.

cloud.meaning: Cloud platforms, hosted infrastructure, cloud migration, SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, or related cloud support.
cloud.boundary: The title must explicitly indicate cloud technology or a named cloud-service model.

cybersecurity.meaning: Information and cybersecurity services, including audits, advisory work, vulnerability testing, security controls, and zero-trust work.
examples: 情報セキュリティ監査
セキュリティ対策支援
cybersecurity.boundary: Physical guarding and general security services are not cybersecurity.

network_infrastructure.meaning: Computer networks, servers, data-center infrastructure, network configuration, and related technical support.
network_infrastructure.boundary: Physical telecommunications towers, public-address radio, CCTV, and data-center industry promotion may be adjacent or out of scope.

end_user_computing.meaning: Setup, configuration, deployment, or preparation of personal computers and end-user devices.
end_user_computing.boundary: General equipment maintenance and office-machine maintenance are not automatically included.

data_digital.meaning: Data platforms, data integration, data migration, digitization, and broader digital-transformation or DX work.
data_digital.boundary: Training, policy support, consulting, video production, and industry-promotion work may be digitally adjacent rather than technical IT delivery.

artificial_intelligence.meaning: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, large language models, RAG, and related AI services or studies.
artificial_intelligence.boundary: AI surveys, education, exhibitions, literacy programs, and policy studies may be AI-adjacent rather than technical AI delivery.

it_consulting_planning.meaning: Technical planning, standardization, procurement support, implementation advice, or consulting for an information system.
examples: 情報システム調達支援
医療情報システム導入コンサルティング
it_consulting_planning.boundary: General business consulting, promotion, policy, and training without an explicit information-system context are outside scope.

high_level_logic.digital_or_ai_adjacent: matches data_digital or artificial_intelligence and does not match core_it_delivery

known_exclusions_or_boundaries: BPR or digital consulting without explicit technical delivery
embedded systems where software work is not explicit
limitations: title-only matching can produce false positives and false negatives
counts represent notices, not necessarily unique underlying projects

lean_revision_principles: Start from frozen v1 rather than either rejected candidate.
Add only reusable procurement concepts, not exact reviewed titles or named equipment models.
Require technical context around ambiguous terms such as network and data center.
Use short activity-level exclusions for training, events, surveys, promotion, and content work.
Do not enumerate physical medical, camera, observation, or building-equipment systems.
Accept and report residual title-only error rather than continually patching regexes.
